response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically versatile senior/staff engineer with genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD setup, MCP tooling) that align with the 'engineering productivity' focus area. However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position requiring 2+ years of direct team leadership, one-on-ones, and performance management, and his resume shows a purely individual-contributor career path with no titles, responsibilities, or evidence of managing people at any point.
strengths: Deep, broad technical background spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure, with 15+ years of hands-on development experience
Direct experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD pipelines, GitLab administration)
Strong communication and mentoring signals via workshops, talks, and Selenium/testing course creation, suggesting some leadership aptitude
concerns: No evidence of people management experience — no direct reports, performance reviews, or team-lead titles anywhere in the work history
Career progression stayed entirely IC-track (Developer/Senior/Staff Engineer) despite 15+ years, with no attempt at formal leadership roles
No mention of organizational change leadership, cross-team strategic roadmap ownership, or managing engineers' performance expectations

key_factors.factor: Relevant developer tooling and testing infrastructure background
No advanced degree or documented organizational-change leadership
